remarks: This cozy main-level 1-bedroom apartment in a single-family home with private entrance, offers a beautiful atmosphere and plenty of storage space. This open concept unit offers new appliances, hardwood floors, and central air conditioning. Imagine coming home to this beautiful and perfectly maintained house located in the quiet Silvermine neighborhood, and conveniently located close to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. You will have one designated parking space in the massive parking lot (two spaces if a couple become tenants). The best part of it all, UTILITIES ARE INCLUDED!!! Please inquire about your pets and excellent credit is a must. The owner reserves the right to interview potential tenants. UPDATE: Applications are currently being reviewed and a tenant will be decided soon, thank you all for your interest.
